title: HHH lean-proofs: exact answers to small probability and counting problems, checked by Lean 4
description: Lean 4 theorems from Humanities Helping Hands (humanitieshelpinghands.com). Each one states, about a problem's own objects (every roll, hand, walk or shuffle), that a count or a chance equals one exact number, and Lean's kernel checks the proof with Mathlib. The repository has no sorry. One command, ./check.sh, re-checks everything from scratch. It also holds a small Lean file showing that checking a proposed SAT answer is fast (P vs NP, piece 1); this is a known fact and does not prove or claim anything about P vs NP itself.
